newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST- Polish repo/revrepo seen down by end-97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- Polish repo/revrepo seen down by end-97.

text.p: Banks expect the central bank's 14-day repo and reverse repo rates to ease by year-end with more players predicting reverse repos than repos, a Reuters poll of Poland's 26 biggest banks showed on Monday.
Four of the polled banks expected the central bank would stage both reverse repo and repo operations or only repos at the end of the year. Last month seven banks expected repos.
The central bank last set the 14-day reverse-repo rate at 22.15 percent. It has not staged any repos since early 1995.
NOTE: In brackets previous figures for end-97 and April-98 from last month's poll.
